customer_reply:
Hello, thank you for contacting Zycus Support. The behavior you are experiencing when attempting to approve 500 purchase orders at once is a by-design platform limit. Bulk approval accepts a maximum of 200 documents per batch to protect approval audit trails, which is why the Approve button is greyed out when more than 200 items are selected.

Workaround:
1. Filter the approval list (for example by supplier or date) to batches of 200 or fewer.
2. Approve each batch.

If you would like to request an increase to this limit, please let us know your typical batch size and we can log this as a feature request for our Product team.
